_comment: Scoped permission allowlist for the unattended PM Weekly run (claude -p /pm-agent, headless). Python runs ONLY through the check wrapper (scripts/pm_agent_run_check.py, which refuses scripts outside PM_AGENT_HOME/checks or naming the Risk Agent's working files or order paths), the state builder and the publisher. NO bypassPermissions and NO web tools. The book is readable (owner 2026-10-09: one user, no wall); the Read denies keep the session off secrets and off the Risk Agent's working files, whose forecasts must not anchor the PM's (docs/claude_ref/pm_agent.md, Independence). The runner adds PM_AGENT_HOME with --add-dir so Write can reach it.
